description: HTML source code for a web-based database visualizer interface with embedded CSS and JavaScript.
external_methods: fetchData (fetch API calls for databases, tables, and data)

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Loads the list of databases from the backend API.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the database list by re-fetching from API.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses the list of tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Loads the list of tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Loads data from a selected table and displays it.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Constructs and displays an HTML table with data rows.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Renders individual cell content, handling nulls, objects, and long text with expand functionality.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content for long or object data.
